findings.source_quote:
The bills pile up for comforts and ease;
“What about our wives, or children to please?”
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the original sentence sense in the first line as a statement rather than a question. Replace the translation of the first line with a declarative Greek sentence (no question mark) to match the English. For example: «Οι λογαριασμοί σωρεύονται για ανέσεις και ευκολία.» Remove the question mark after ευκολία and keep the following line as the rhetorical question as translated.
findings.translation_quote:
Οι λογαριασμοί σωρεύονται για ανέσεις και ευκολία;
«Τι να κάνουμε με τις συζύγους μας ή τα παιδιά, για να τα ευχαριστήσουμε;»
